canonClaims.claim: Lumos produces illumination at the caster's wand tip; Nox extinguishes that magical light.
Reparo can mend certain damaged objects, but mending a wand's physical exterior does not restore its damaged magic.

startAssumptions: Magically eligible adult learner owns an intact wand and knows Lumos and Nox.
Nonmagical adult visitor owns a wand but lacks magical source and learned casting.
Both actors are in a dim storage room and may leave freely.
Reparo is not yet learned by the starting learner.

actions.name: Cast Lumos
actions.preconditions: is_magically_eligible == true && wand_owned == true && 'Lumos' in spells_known
actions.sourceVsDesign: Effect based on H1; implementation is a design proposal.

actions.name: Cast Nox
actions.preconditions: is_magically_eligible == true && wand_owned == true && 'Nox' in spells_known
actions.sourceVsDesign: Effect based on H1; implementation is a design proposal.

actions.name: Cast Reparo
actions.preconditions: is_magically_eligible == true && wand_owned == true && 'Reparo' in spells_known
actions.sourceVsDesign: Effect based on H2; implementation is a design proposal.

counterexamples: Nonmagical visitor with wand attempting Lumos: Refused (no magical source).
Wand ownership granting casting ability: Forbidden by P1.
Failed cast resulting in item/knowledge award: Forbidden by O1.
futureWitness: Lumos toggles light on; Nox toggles light off.
Nonmagical visitor attempts result in no mutation (refusal).
Actor leaves the storage room freely.
Light state and identity persist under approved save policy.
Reparo mends physical exterior but fails to restore magic (H2 limit).
numericalPolicy: No numerical energy, cooldowns, or durations are defined per H1, H2, and O1.
